title: Associates and Joint Arrangements
intro: **نفوذ مؤثر** (عادة 20% أو أكثر) ← شركة شقيقة ← طريقة حقوق الملكية.
**سيطرة مشتركة** تحتاج موافقة **بالإجماع**: مشروع مشترك (حقوق ملكية) أو عملية مشتركة (حصتك في الأصول والالتزامات).

tf.s: Holding 20% or more of the voting power is presumed to give significant influence.
Joint ventures are accounted for using the equity method.
A joint operator recognises its share of assets, liabilities, revenue and expenses.
tf.why: It has rights to assets and obligations for liabilities.

tf.s: Joint control exists when decisions need a simple majority.
tf.why: Unanimous consent of the parties sharing control is needed.

tf.s: Under the equity method, dividends received increase the investment.
Unrealised profits on transactions with an associate are eliminated to the extent of the investor's interest.

fill.s: An associate is an entity over which the investor has significant ___.
A joint venture is accounted for using the ___ method.
Joint control needs ___ consent of the parties sharing control.
Under the equity method, dividends received ___ the carrying amount.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.

je.s: The investor's share of the associate's profit is 30,000.
je.why: Equity method: the investment grows with the share of profit.

je.s: A dividend of 10,000 is received from the associate.

calc.s: Bought 30% of an associate for 400,000. Associate profit 200,000; it paid dividends of 50,000. Carrying amount at year-end?
Investor (25%) sold goods to its associate at a profit of 40,000. All are still in the associate's inventory. Unrealised profit to eliminate?

steps: Add the share of post-acquisition profit (and OCI)
Eliminate the share of unrealised profits
Test for impairment if there are indicators

items: 50/50, unanimous decisions, rights to net assets

multi.why: 5% alone, with no other rights, does not give influence.
